manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {2}{R}{G}.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster triggers, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster triggers, dealing 2 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.
